title: Suspicious Script Execution on MCHD-INT01

fields.rule: Suspicious script execution in root directory with file deletion pattern
fields.ruleDescription: A script named 'auto_cleaner.py' executed every 15 minutes on MCHD-INT01, deleting entries from the nightly IIS export file. The script has no digital signature and is not in the approved software inventory.
fields.rawEvent:
2026-10-22T09:00:12-05:00 MCHD-INT01 /usr/bin/python3 auto_cleaner.py --delete-entries --from=IIS-EXPORT-NIGHTLY.v261024.hl7 --target=hl7_dose_records.json

[INFO] Script execution successful. 412 records removed from export.

[WARN] No digital signature detected on script.

[ERROR] Script not listed in approved software inventory (MCHD-FAC-SYS-2026, rev 2.0).

relatedAlerts.title: Unusual Process Execution: python3 on MCHD-INT01

instructorNote: This inject confirms the presence of malicious persistence on MCHD-INT01. The IT team must immediately initiate the interface pause procedure and begin forensic isolation of MCHD-INT01.
